source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 5 May 1927, p. 11 ("Rural council and guardians: Newtownards nominations")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: Names and divisions read on the block images of the News-Letter's nominations report (5 May 1927, p. 11, article BNL19270505.2.229) and results (4 June 1927, p. 8, article BNL19270604.2.190).

note: Triennial election of the Newtownards (later North Down) rural district councillors, one for each of eighteen divisions; nominations received by Mr. John Warden, deputy returning officer, on 4 May 1927. Ballywalter was the only contest, polled Thursday 2 June 1927 and declared the next day; in Crawfordsburn, Groomsport, Portaferry and Quintin no nomination was received and the retiring members were deemed re-elected. No party labels are printed. Sole nomination (old member); returned unopposed. Returned unopposed.
